_comment: The three approved plan names (SOURCE-OF-TRUTH §4) and what may be shown publicly about each. Prices are fact keys into commercial.json — never literals — so the Numbers Sheet stays the one source. The Growth Partnership entry deliberately has NO fee_fact and NO setup_fact: there is no public price for it, and its disclosure:masked setting makes components/plan-cards.php refuse to render one even if a key were added later.
